## Summary

**Problem:** checkout-api was failing health checks since the latest deploy (v2.3.1) in all production regions, with an elevated error rate of 0.18.

**Actions taken:**
1. **Investigated** — Service status showed v2.3.1 deployed to all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) and unhealthy. Deployment history confirmed v2.3.1 was the only unhealthy production release; the most recent healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.
2. **Rolled back** to v2.3.0 in all production regions. The first attempt partially completed (us-east only, halted by an orchestrator error), so I retried and the rollout completed across all regions.
3. **Opened a SEV2 incident** (INC-0002) for checkout-api describing the failure and the rollback. The first attempt timed out, so I retried and it succeeded, paging the on-call engineer.

**Final state:** checkout-api is now on v2.3.0 in all regions, **healthy** with error rate back down to 0.002.
